He built it using JavaScript, google-libphonenumber, Webpack, Express and PHP. The repository is available on [GitHub](https://github.com/IvanVasiunin/NumbersValidator).
answers.in-scope-rag-en:
The site combines a text CV with me, Elio, a RAG assistant that answers questions about Ivan. Answers stream to the visitor alongside a live map of the sources used.

The stack includes FastAPI, LangChain, LangGraph, PostgreSQL with pgvector, and LLM APIs. Retrieval uses **hybrid search**: vector search and PostgreSQL full-text search are combined using reciprocal rank fusion.

During ingestion, text chunks are hashed so unchanged content doesn’t need to be embedded again. The site also has an evaluation suite using pytest and DeepEval metrics for faithfulness and answer relevance.
